rationale: Select own colour plus nearest nonzero colours up, down, left, and right. Demonstration 1 changes bottom-left 0 to 9 with directional neighbours (3,-1,-1,1). Demonstrations 3 and 7 change bottom-left 1 to 5 with neighbours (2,-1,-1,1). Demonstration 7 also changes row 1, column 4 from 0 to 2 with neighbours (-1,3,-1,2), using zero-based coordinates. Other observed keys retain their colours.

Select own colour plus zero-based row and column modulo 3. Zeros become 8 at phase (1,1), and 3 at phases (0,2), (2,1), and (2,2); other colours and phases remain unchanged. Demonstration 3 shows these phases repeating across columns 1 and 4, columns 2 and 5, and rows separated by three.
